content_units.safe_meaning: Establish Mara's ferry work, the flood-night pressure, and the missing lower-dock route.
Force Mara to possess the coded map and brass lens instead of safely reporting them.
Show Mara using unofficial help after Venn shuts the public route.
Reveal that the lower-dock route was deliberately hidden and redirect Mara toward broadcast.
Make Mara pay a personal cost for keeping the route public.
Force the final private-versus-public choice through Niko's injury.
Pay off the lantern clue and Mara's public-trust choice in the tower.
Show evacuation success, Mara's loss, and the new trust she earns.

composition_plan.central_question: Will Mara risk her ferry license and safety to broadcast the true evacuation routes before the river wall fails?
composition_plan.central_throughline: A night ferry pilot finds a hidden evacuation map and must choose between preserving her license and warning the flood district before the warning tower is sealed.
composition_plan.opening_job: A night ferry pilot finds a hidden evacuation map and must choose between preserving her license and warning the flood district before the warning tower is sealed.
composition_plan.conclusion_job: Mara gets the lens into the warning tower and signals the lower-dock route in time.

planned_units.title: lantern-map-short-story
planned_units.reader_job: A night ferry pilot finds a hidden evacuation map and must choose between preserving her license and warning the flood district before the warning tower is sealed.
planned_units.relation_to_previous: Mara earns a fragile living by keeping the lower-dock ferry running and staying invisible to the council.
planned_units.incoming_reader_state: Mara earns a fragile living by keeping the lower-dock ferry running and staying invisible to the council.
planned_units.outgoing_reader_state: Mara gets the lens into the warning tower and signals the lower-dock route in time.

planned_units.title: setup
planned_units.reader_job: The flood bell is announced for midnight as the lower docks keep working.
planned_units.relation_to_previous: Mara works a dangerous ferry shift while avoiding council notice.
planned_units.incoming_reader_state: Mara works a dangerous ferry shift while avoiding council notice.
planned_units.outgoing_reader_state: Mara suspects the official warning plan is incomplete.

planned_units.title: first_plot_point
planned_units.reader_job: An apprentice named Jin leaves Mara a coded map and brass lens.
planned_units.relation_to_previous: Mara could hand the strange lens to the council and remain uninvolved.
planned_units.incoming_reader_state: Mara could hand the strange lens to the council and remain uninvolved.
planned_units.outgoing_reader_state: Mara becomes the only person outside the council with the route map and lens.

planned_units.title: reaction
planned_units.reader_job: Venn closes the public archive route and orders ferry locks inspected.
planned_units.relation_to_previous: Mara searches for proof while trying to keep the ferry route legal.
planned_units.incoming_reader_state: Mara searches for proof while trying to keep the ferry route legal.
planned_units.outgoing_reader_state: Mara has an unofficial path toward the tower but is now being watched.

planned_units.title: midpoint
planned_units.reader_job: The map shows the lower-dock route was deliberately removed from public boards.
planned_units.relation_to_previous: Mara believes the map is only evidence of council incompetence.
planned_units.incoming_reader_state: Mara believes the map is only evidence of council incompetence.
planned_units.outgoing_reader_state: Mara has a public mission and can no longer frame the problem as self-protection.

planned_units.title: attack
planned_units.reader_job: Venn issues an arrest notice and cuts the service lamps along the flood wall.
planned_units.relation_to_previous: Mara moves toward the tower with the map and lens.
planned_units.incoming_reader_state: Mara moves toward the tower with the map and lens.
planned_units.outgoing_reader_state: Mara can reach the tower but loses the easy way to defend her license afterward.

planned_units.title: second_plot_point
planned_units.reader_job: Niko is hurt while holding the tunnel gate open.
planned_units.relation_to_previous: Mara has tower access but still hopes to save both Niko and her license.
planned_units.incoming_reader_state: Mara has tower access but still hopes to save both Niko and her license.
planned_units.outgoing_reader_state: Mara chooses the public warning over the private rescue she can personally finish.

planned_units.title: climax
planned_units.reader_job: Mara mounts the lens and turns the lantern toward the lower docks.
planned_units.relation_to_previous: Mara reaches the tower while Venn orders the lens surrendered.
planned_units.incoming_reader_state: Mara reaches the tower while Venn orders the lens surrendered.
planned_units.outgoing_reader_state: The true route is public, and Mara's violation is undeniable.

planned_units.title: resolution
planned_units.reader_job: Residents return the ferry bell to Mara after the water drops.
planned_units.relation_to_previous: The district follows the lantern route while Mara waits for punishment.
planned_units.incoming_reader_state: The district follows the lantern route while Mara waits for punishment.
planned_units.outgoing_reader_state: Mara begins rebuilding as a public witness rather than a hidden ferry pilot.
